honest_boundary: The repository implements all requested controls, but actual independent DTI, wet-lab, independent-laboratory and multi-site evidence cannot be manufactured. Evidence scores rise only after authentic immutable outcomes and signed independent reviews are imported.

validation.boundary: The repository cannot manufacture wet-lab, independent laboratory or multi-site evidence. Those scores are evidence-gated by design.

capabilities.boundary: 10/10 implementation means enforceable schemas, hashes, chronology, split policies, calibration, review and release gates exist. Actual evidence reaches 10/10 only after qualifying independent datasets or genuine laboratory/site results are imported.
